research.title: Baseline Classification of Clarification Requests in Dialogue
bullets: Prepared dialogue excerpts for classification by standardizing text fields, checking annotation consistency, and removing duplicate conversations across predefined data splits.
Implemented TF-IDF and logistic regression baselines using scikit-learn, then summarized classification errors involving indirect questions and context-dependent clarification requests.

work.title: Inventory and Order Processing Support
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing lists, recorded discrepancies, and routed damaged or missing items to the appropriate staff for follow-up.
Prepared routine order paperwork, maintained organized stock records, and coordinated collection times with customers using established scheduling procedures.

projects.title: Lexical Baselines for Product Review Sentiment
bullets: Implemented unigram and bigram TF-IDF representations with a multinomial naive Bayes classifier for positive and negative product review classification.
Compared feature configurations on a held-out validation split and inspected misclassified reviews containing negation, mixed sentiment, and domain-specific vocabulary.

projects.title: Extractive Summarization with Sentence Similarity
bullets: Implemented an extractive summarization baseline that ranked sentences by cosine similarity between sentence TF-IDF vectors and the document centroid.
Compared selected sentences with a lead-sentence baseline, examining reference-summary overlap and documenting redundancy and missing context in generated summaries.
